design: Exact finite registered mechanism calculation. No sampled histories.
timing: Decide once at t=3. Historical audit for each earlier event is visible exactly when event+lag <=3. Current choices see the two primary reports and one alternative report. Verification is optional, costs the same for every arm and emits a current truth signal. After verification choose accept or reject.
primary: Under the duplicate law, compare the long-minus-short change in exact expected loss for adaptive naive versus adaptive dependence-aware policies. Other environments and metrics are diagnostic.
confidence: P(Y=1) is the internal decision probability before verification. The separate simulated report doubles its log odds and is never used for the action. Score both, plus action coverage and verification use.
